A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CBC is a component of the RNP particle that is involved in several aspects of pre-mRNP metabolism, from splicing and nuclear RNA transport to cytoplasmic mRNA translation.
CBC is a nuclear pre-RNP particle marker, and it may be involved in the nuclear export of a subset of RNA polymerase II transcripts in Chironomus.

The main takeaway from our work is that
CBC is an integral part of the RNP particle during its entire nuclear transit, which suggests a possible role in the assembly and/or maintenance of the pre-mRNA structure during nuclear export.
